cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Pick a Priority
cards.instruction: Make someone choose between two ordinary obligations that both supposedly cannot wait.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Your parents' gravy needs stirring and you need a lift to the station. Which am I doing?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can't you leave dinner on a timer?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. It won't stir the gravy. Do I finish their dinner or drive you?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Finish dinner. I'll book a taxi. Just carry my suitcase downstairs.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then choose again: suitcase downstairs now, or gravy without lumps for your parents?

mechanism: A uses cooking expertise to prevent B collapsing two immediate duties into one, forcing a clear priority again when B taxi solution adds a suitcase task.
confusable: Ordinary time management might divide tasks; A insists B must choose which pressing obligation gets A attention.
comparison: Depot alternative uses travel deadlines and phone interruption; gravy scene uses continuous cooking attention versus physical transport help.
seedUse: Gravy, station lift, timer and suitcase derive from D34-a; S03 deepens the actual timer/stirring correction already present.
